recognize_zh: 高倍CD20染色下，腦內小血管管腔擠滿細胞膜強陽性（棕色）的大型B細胞，核大、染色質空泡狀，血管壁外的腦實質細胞核則全為藍色陰性，是血管內大B細胞淋巴瘤的典型免疫染色表現。
features: Large tumor cells with strong, crisp membranous and cytoplasmic CD20 positivity
Tumor cells packed within vessel lumina, conforming to vessel shape, with a retraction space separating the vessel from surrounding neuropil
Nuclei are large (several times a glial nucleus), round to oval, with vesicular chromatin and unstained nuclear centers
Single CD20-positive cells present in smaller capillaries
Surrounding glial and endothelial nuclei are CD20-negative; no extravascular positive cells
describe_en: High-power CD20 immunohistochemistry shows small vessels in brain parenchyma distended by large atypical lymphoid cells with strong membranous and cytoplasmic CD20 staining. The neoplastic cells have enlarged vesicular nuclei and are confined to the vessel lumina, including individual positive cells within capillaries. The adjacent neuropil contains only CD20-negative glial nuclei without extravascular spread. Findings are consistent with intravascular large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Primary CNS diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Primary CNS DLBCL shows CD20-positive cells infiltrating into brain parenchyma around vessels rather than remaining purely intraluminal.
Its tumor cells are CD20-negative and positive for CD3epsilon, CD56, cytotoxic granule proteins and EBER.
Carcinoma cells are CD20-negative and cytokeratin-positive, forming epithelial nests with more cytoplasm.
